title: ephedra strobilacea subsp. microbracteata
intro: Ephedra strobilacea subsp. microbracteata, commonly known as Dwarf Ephedra, is a type of flowering plant belonging to the Ephedraceae family. It is known for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as aiding in weight loss, improving respiratory function, and boosting energy levels. The therapeutic actions of Dwarf Ephedra include acting as a bronchodilator, diaphoretic, and stimulant, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents responsible for its therapeutic effects include ephedrine, pseudoephedrine, and other alkaloids, which have been found to possess anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties.
